dosing_schedule: For ear pain: Give one dose every 6 hours or until the ear pain is gone. Give mother enough for 1 day (4 doses).

dose_2_to_12_months: Pediatric tablet (20mg trimethoprim/100mg sulphamethoxazole): 2 tablets twice daily for 5 days. Syrup: 5 ml twice daily.
dose_12_months_to_5_years: Pediatric tablet: 3 tablets twice daily for 5 days. Syrup: 7.5 ml twice daily.
contraindications: Avoid in a young infant less than 1 month of age who is premature or jaundiced.

dose_2_to_12_months: Syrup (125mg/5ml): 5 ml three times daily for 5 days.
dose_12_months_to_5_years: Syrup (125mg/5ml): 10 ml three times daily for 5 days.

dosing_schedule: Give for 3 days. Dose is reduced on the third day unless child weighs <10kg and giving 150mg base tablets.
side_effects: Itching is a possible side effect.

dosing_schedule: Give 2 doses. First dose in clinic, second dose next day at home. Danger of overdose if repeated too frequently.
Give syrup to child <12 months. Give tablets if >=12 months. One dose daily for 14 days.
side_effects: May make stools black. Overdose can be fatal.
contraindications: Do not give with sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine if iron syrup contains folate.

indications: Hookworm or whipworm infection contributing to anaemia in children >= 2 years
dosing_schedule: 500 mg mebendazole as a single dose in clinic.
